ssot_verification_guardrail_for_v3.rule: Never trust a constants file, barrel export, or named SSOT without grepping consumers to verify they actually import from it. Every SSOT claim in V3 architecture must cite a consumer-verification grep.

v3_architecture_constraints_corrected.description: CORRECTED constraint list incorporating all Codex findings. Numbered same as v1 where applicable for diff clarity; asterisk denotes correction.
constraints: C1* (CORRECTED): CSS variable definitions exist in SIX files with at least SIX distinct roles (compound default.css has: canonical root, alias layer, dead scope rules, keyframes), PLUS the seventh --accent-* sibling prefix. Any two-bucket architecture is insufficient — even a four-role architecture is insufficient.

C2: Demo app depends on a file V2 treated as legacy dead (components/Canvas/Canvas.css). Deleting without demo migration breaks editor-embed flow. ALSO components/Canvas/index.ts is the stable public export path — cannot simply remove.

C3* (EXPANDED): ux-fixes.css is a chrome consumer that V2 missed AND has global side effects (*:focus-visible), own keyframes, and utility classes. Not a passive file. Every spec must enumerate themes/ directory contents + verify each file's role components.
C4* (RECLASSIFIED AS QUESTION, NOT CONSTRAINT): design-tokens.css defines GLOBAL :root tokens. QUESTION: merge into default.css, keep as separate module, or reclassify as output-tokens namespace?
C5* (RECLASSIFIED AS QUESTION): Two Canvas.css files overlap. QUESTION: consolidate, or keep transition redirect pattern intact?

C6: 'aqb' prefix is multi-semantic (CSS vars + keyframes + classnames + data attrs + storage keys + public API + user-export HTML + engine CSS_CLASSES contract + aqb:trace: debug flags + --accent-* sibling system). Renaming 'aqb' wholesale is NOT token-scope work.
C7: data-aqb-* and user-export .aqb-* class names appear in user-exported HTML. Changing them is a breaking change for exported sites, needs separate compatibility planning.

C8: Storage keys have TWO organization patterns (centralized in storageKeys.ts AND ad-hoc inline) AND contain duplicates across the two. Any rename must reconcile 48 centralized + ~20 ad-hoc, including duplicates.
C9: applyTheme() has ONE real caller (demo/main.tsx:21). Deleting requires demo handling. Plus src/index.ts:75 re-exports it as public API.

C10* (CORRECTED): 29 undefined-but-consumed tokens (not 5), classified: 2 comment-only placeholders, 3 runtime-written by design-system hooks (mixed — some of those ALSO have static defs), 6 truly live-no-fallback, 7 masked by var() fallback, plus 11 other runtime-writer mixed cases.
C11: Two orphan @keyframes references (aqb-slide-down in TWO callsites, aqb-bar-slide-up in one). Pre-existing dead code.

C12* (CORRECTED): Persisted design-token runtime writes a MIXED set of CSS vars — 48 overlap statically-defined (--aqb-space-*, --aqb-radius-*, --aqb-layout-*, --aqb-btn-*, --aqb-icon-*) and 20 are runtime-only (--aqb-color-primary etc.). NOT 'all undefined-variable behavior' as V2 claimed. Some design-token writes PROPERLY update static vars; others create new ones that chrome can't consume.
C13 (NEW): Triple persistence for canvas design tokens — localStorage-direct + Composer id-name-load + Composer projectSettings-pipeline. Any data migration must address all three or risk divergence.
C14 (NEW): --accent-* sibling prefix exists alongside --aqb-*. Aliased via --aqb-primary → --accent → #2D6DFF. V3 rename strategy must explicitly decide what happens to --accent-*.

C15 (NEW): CSS_CLASSES constant in config.ts is an engine class-name contract (aqb-canvas, aqb-selected, aqb-dragging, etc.). Renaming class prefix requires updating this constant + all engine modules that query [class*='aqb-'].

C16 (NEW): Some 'aqb-*' storage keys are DUPLICATED across centralized + inline definitions (aqb-panel-state, aqb-elements-*, aqb-recent-templates, aqb-project). Pre-existing inconsistency; rename must deduplicate.

meta_reflection_on_inventory_production_.description: Patterns observed across V1 (prefix migration), V2 (2-namespace split), and v1/v2 of this inventory. Intended to improve future migration work.
patterns_observed: Pattern 1 (V1, V2): Architecture before inventory. Fixed in v1 of this inventory (did inventory first).
Pattern 2 (v1 of inventory): Bucket-driven normalization — invented 8 buckets and rounded off data that didn't fit. Codex caught.

Pattern 3 (risk for v3): Analyst fatigue — after enough grep passes, impulse is to declare 'good enough' and move on. --accent-* was only discovered in v2 because a specific grep happened to include --accent in its pattern.

Pattern 4 (structural): Multiple organization conventions coexist uncomfortably — centralized constants vs inline strings, single vs duplicate Canvas.css, compound default.css with 4 distinct roles. This is codebase debt, not just naming debt. V3 should treat structural debt as separate concern from rename debt.
recommended_defenses_for_v3: Run Codex on the architecture BEFORE writing it (not just after). Pre-architecture Codex challenges catch premises.
For any claim 'X has N elements/references/instances', always verify with a reproducible command output. Do not round to memorable numbers.
Treat structural-debt cleanup and rename-debt cleanup as two separate specs. Don't bundle.
